unreleased.summary: Prepared for HyprCapture 0.3.0: native scrolling screenshots, an in-place editor, desktop pins, and Hymission Stage capture.

sections.title: New
items: Native scrolling screenshots: scroll inside a selected region or window in the editor to grow a long image, revisit captured content, and keep annotations aligned with the page.
In-place screenshot editor through `open_editor()`: rectangles, ellipses, arrows, lines, pen, highlighter, numbered markers, mosaic, spotlight, undo/redo, and zoom/pan.
Movable, resizable multiline text boxes with a floating toolbar for font, pixel size, and color.
Desktop pins that stay above normal windows and then follow the normal save, clipboard, and thumbnail flow.
UI translations for Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, German, French, Spanish, and Korean, selected through the new `language` option.
Capture windows from Hymission Stage, center them in the editor, and match selection outlines to their displayed rounded corners.

sections.title: Faster
items: The capture overlay starts sooner: the Qt helper launches in parallel with compositor capture, and panels and icons are created on demand and cached.
Frozen screenshot artifacts are memory-mapped instead of copied pixel by pixel.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Recordings no longer hang when the compositor was started from a terminal; the recorder's stdin now comes from /dev/null (#25, contributed by Vedaru).

Nix build fixes for #29: read-only store paths whose owner is unmapped inside the build sandbox are now trusted (writable paths are still rejected), and supervised processes handle stop signals under BusyBox ash. A sandboxed build of the repository flake passed its tests locally; the reporter's own setup has not been verified yet.
Microphone-only recordings ignore changes to application audio, and only capture dropdown settings are persisted.
Toolbar icons now use Google Material Symbols and render sharply at any scale.

Fix region scrolling captures that stayed at their original size or misaligned during small movements and repeated text; foreground detail aligns scrolling text over a stationary smooth background, with safer history matching and fixed-header detection.
Flush pointer motion before forwarding touchpad scrolling so applications such as Zen receive input at the intended capture position.
Keep the captured window foreground separate from the real or blurred background, and preserve editable backgrounds after a scrolling capture.
Preserve top-origin monitor crops in region recordings (#32) and editor geometry when creating scaled desktop pins (#33).
Reset offscreen render state between monitor captures and stabilize asynchronous UI/audio regression checks.

sections.title: Upgrade notes
items: Remove the old `in_place_edit_toolbar` setting and bind `hl.plugin.hyprcapture.open_editor()` for editing. `open()` retains its confirmation behavior and `quick()` captures directly.
Build against Hyprland 0.56.2 and update both the plugin and Qt helper. Scrolling image matching adds an OpenCV dependency.
Update Hymission alongside HyprCapture to use the Stage renderer's exact selection radius; older Hymission versions use a scaled-radius fallback.

sections.title: Validation and remaining checks
items: Release build and automated regression coverage, including isolated GTK scrolling, scale-2 region stitching, independent backgrounds, and Stage selection geometry. A stationary-backdrop fixture preserves opaque foreground pixels exactly; it does not claim whole-image equality for a background that does not scroll.
Production-desktop kitty and physical touchpad/touchscreen acceptance remain pending after updating the plugin and helper. Dynamic or ambiguous page content may require recovering overlap.

releases.headline: Audio recording, echo cancellation, and accurate video timing

sections.title: Recording
items: Videos keep the frames' real capture timestamps instead of accumulating repeated frames, so audio stays in sync.
Oversized automatic recordings prefer hardware HEVC encoding.
Audio modes, device selection, application audio capture, mixing presets, manual gain controls, and live level meters.

Echo cancellation through PipeWire WebRTC, plus a native DTLN-AEC candidate with a validated CPU selection policy and optional OpenVINO NPU support. Real-recording, speech-quality, and long-duration acceptance tests are still pending.
First-frame recording previews, a finalization animation, centered recording controls, and optional restoration of capture settings.

sections.title: Performance and reliability
items: Less window-capture work thanks to compact render targets and cached GPU exports.
Fenced window streaming, frame-bound input geometry, and checks on the capture target's lifecycle.
Better handling of rotated and scaled outputs, encoder/backend fallback, countdown cancellation, screenshot notifications, window selection controls, and narrow toolbars.

sections.title: Build
items: New build dependency: FFmpeg development libraries (libavformat, libavcodec, libavutil). Install the DTLN runtime and models with the included AEC scripts.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Window screenshots keep the selected background mode; real and transparent output no longer fall back to follow-system.
Painted window backgrounds are clipped to the visible rounded frame, while transparent edge and shadow pixels are kept.
Window artifacts are rendered straight into an RGBA framebuffer through Hyprland's snapshot path, preserving client alpha without heuristic matte recovery.

sections.title: Changed
items: All plugin actions and helper callbacks now go through the Hyprland Lua API. Legacy dispatcher registration and fallback paths have been removed (#20).
README configuration and key-binding examples are written in Lua.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Immutable Nix store paths are accepted, while writable child directories and executables are still rejected (#19).

releases.headline: Hyprland 0.56 support and a Nix flake

sections.title: New
items: Compatibility with Hyprland 0.56 and Nix flake packaging.
Configurable notification backends and a recording-state socket for status bars and other integrations.
The `hyprcam` watermark preset.

sections.title: Improved
items: Complete fusion capture interactions, plus better multi-monitor overlays, synchronized thumbnails, and monitor targeting.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Captures and recordings on transformed monitors, fullscreen recording, scrolling-window selection, cursor capture, and fullscreen preview geometry.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fullscreen screenshots on transformed multi-monitor layouts no longer crop or invert rotated secondary outputs.
Unsafe compositor readback state, which could crash Hyprland or capture the overlay blur, is avoided.

sections.title: Faster
items: Result thumbnails appear sooner because a small preview launches before the full-size PNG save and clipboard work finish.

sections.title: New
items: Windows can be captured from the hymission overview.

sections.title: Fixed
items: The first click now captures correctly in hymission overview windows.
Result thumbnails scale better on high-DPI displays.

sections.title: New
items: A trusted, private FIFO export-pipe backend that streams fullscreen compositor RGBA frames to external programs.
The export pipe is available through both the hyprctl dispatcher and the Lua config API.
Documentation of the FIFO capture request and response protocol.

sections.title: Improved
items: Faster window shadow synthesis that uses Hyprland-style shadow geometry and falloff.
Compositor window recordings stay on the compositor backend instead of silently falling back to visible GSR when alpha is unavailable.
Recordings keep window shadows and are cropped only when shadow removal is requested.
When the output cannot carry alpha, shadows are composited over the selected solid or follow-system background.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Lua fallback dispatch from the helper, and the overlay now fades out before window rendering and saving.

releases.headline: Renamed to HyprCapture, fusion mode, and watermarks

sections.title: New
items: The project is now called HyprCapture.
Fusion toolbar mode: a single click captures fullscreen, and gestures combine region and window capture.
Configurable watermarks with built-in Activate Linux and HyperCam-style presets, plus position, size, and offset controls.

sections.title: Improved
items: Lower capture latency: the overlay closes without waiting for saving, clipboard, and thumbnail work.
Simpler region capture, updated toolbar icons and status, cleaner cancel and dropdown controls, and no window titles in window mode.
Installation steps and default helper path guidance for hyprpm.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Real-background window sampling.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Fullscreen, region, and window capture modes with a frozen compositor snapshot behind the overlay.
Fullscreen and region output at display resolution.
Window artifacts rendered by the compositor, including windows that are occluded or partly off-screen.
Window background modes: follow system, white, black, real background, and transparent, with optional border and shadow removal.
Save to file, persistent Wayland clipboard output through wl-copy, and result thumbnails with open, copy, and delete actions.
